note: Family-owned campground on the Cedar River at 1862 River Rd north of Beaverton, on two levels; primitive and tent sites besides the RV sites, two sandy river beaches for swimming and tubing, kayak and tube rentals (by appointment) with upriver shuttles, and themed Saturday events on holiday weekends. No EV charging allowed. Not on RV Life; Google 4.8 over 93 reviews. --Claude
summary: Operator's own site (RoverPass-hosted) + its RoverPass booking engine: $35 base (30/50-amp electric back-in) to $40 (pull-through) for 2026 (confirmed; no mandatory park fee), 50-amp and water (confirmed), rigs to 40 ft with pull-throughs (new), showers/drinking water/dump (new), season May 2 - October 30 from the engine's closure dates (new), reservable on RoverPass up to 6 months ahead (new). 2027 not on sale yet. Price gate: $35, under US$50. Presence: working website with phone 989-491-0099 (matches) and a claimed, bookable RoverPass engine. Not long-stay in character (nightly rates and nightly bookings; weekly/monthly are options). Site count not stated. Note trimmed of field restatements.
